evidence.quote: Similar to Auto Scaling on individual AWS resources, AWS Auto Scaling is free to use. AWS Auto Scaling is enabled by Amazon CloudWatch, so service fees apply for CloudWatch and your application resources (such as Amazon EC2 instances, Elastic Load Balancing load balancers, etc.).

claim: AWS Auto Scaling is free to use; because it is enabled by Amazon CloudWatch, service fees apply for CloudWatch and for your application resources, such as EC2 instances and Elastic Load Balancing load balancers.
